تعتزلوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَزِلُوا (taʕtazilū) /taʕ.ta.zi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# تُعْتَزَلُوا (tuʕtazalū) /tuʕ.ta.za.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
